speaker: Doctor
text: The normal peripheral smear is unexpected given the high white count, so I need to rule out other causes for the leg pain and bruising. Has she had any recent viral illnesses, and does she have any pain or swelling in her abdomen or lymph nodes? REQUEST TEST: Bone_Marrow_Biopsy
